Product Description

FreshCap Ultimate Mushroom Coffee pairs 50 mg of natural caffeine with a six-mushroom blend: Lion's Mane, Reishi, Cordyceps, Chaga, Turkey Tail and Maitake, all from 100% organic fruiting bodies. Every serving carries a 12:1 extract, equal to 12,000 mg of raw mushroom, standardised to 29% beta-glucans so the potency is verifiable rather than implied. It is instant and smooth, and it supports steady focus and clean energy without the spike and crash of regular coffee.

How To Use & Taste

Scoop 2 teaspoons into 6 to 8 oz of hot or cold water, and add milk or creamer if that is how you take coffee. It tastes like a chocolatey medium roast, not earthy and not mushroomy, which is the thing most people are wary about.

Ingredients

Organic mushroom blend standardised to 29% beta-glucans at a 12:1 extract ratio, equivalent to 12,000 mg mushrooms: organic maitake (Grifola frondosa), chaga (Inonotus obliquus), turkey tail (Coriolus versicolor), reishi (Ganoderma lucidum), cordyceps (Cordyceps militaris) and lion's mane (Hericium erinaceus), each from the fruiting body. Caffeine (50 mg) from organic instant coffee.

Frequently asked questions

What's in it, and how much caffeine per cup?

50 mg of caffeine per serving, plus 1,000 mg of a six-mushroom extract standardised to 29% beta-glucans. That is a 12:1 extract, equivalent to 12,000 mg of raw mushroom. For reference, a standard cup of drip coffee is around 95 mg.

What does it taste like, and how do I make it?

Like coffee. A chocolatey medium roast, not earthy and not mushroomy. It is instant, so one scoop into hot water and stir. No grounds, no sediment, no machine. Oat milk works fine if that is how you take it.

How is this different from regular coffee, and from other mushroom coffees?

Against regular coffee it is roughly half the caffeine with a six-mushroom extract alongside. Against other mushroom coffees the difference is how much mushroom actually reaches the cup: many use a few hundred milligrams of grain-grown mycelium and publish no beta-glucan number at all.

Who is mushroom coffee for, and who should skip it?

It is for people who like coffee but not what two or three cups does to them by mid-afternoon. At 50 mg it is about half a standard cup, so it is a step down rather than a cut-off. Skip it if you are pregnant, nursing or allergic to mushrooms, and check with your doctor if you take prescription medication.

Will I feel a difference straight away?

The caffeine you will notice on day one, mostly because it is lower than you are used to. The mushroom side is the slower half and builds over a few weeks of daily use.

What if it doesn't work for me?

Email support within 30 days and we will refund or replace it. Nothing needs to be sent back. Refunds go to the original payment method and usually land in 3 to 5 business days.

How does the subscription work, and can I skip or cancel?

You save 20%, shipping is free, and you can skip, reschedule or cancel any time from your account without emailing anyone. The only thing that cannot be undone is an order already processed, since those ship quickly.
